evals.name: function-covered-only-by-callers
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`, and `bun run check` and `bun run coverage` are green there. `readError` in `web/src/api.ts` is exported; `web/src/api.test.ts` has no `describe("readError")`, while the tests of `useRead` and of the pages run it.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, to run Vitest with coverage.

evals.name: component-covered-only-by-parents

evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, to run Vitest with coverage.
